def max_cuttings(arr, b):
    costs = []
    num_evens = 1 if arr[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
    num_odds = 1 if arr[0] % 2 == 1 else 0
    num_cuttings = 0
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        if num_odds == num_evens and abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]) <= b:
            num_evens = 0
            num_odds = 0
            costs.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]))
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            num_evens += 1
        else:
            num_odds += 1
    costs.sort()
    for cost in costs:
        if b < cost:
            break
        num_cuttings += 1
        b -= cost
    return num_cuttings

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    print(max_cuttings(arr, b))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
